name: AI for Database
description: Queries PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB and SQL Server in plain English via a scoped REST API and OAuth-gated remote MCP server, with read-only SQL, dashboards, webhooks and scheduled workflows.

skills.name: Natural Language Query
skills.description: Runs plain-English questions against a connected PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB or SQL Server database via POST /connections/{id}/query, executed as read-only SQL.

skills.name: Manage Connections
skills.description: Lists, inspects and configures database connections through the /connections endpoints under the connections API-key scope.

skills.name: Database Chat
skills.description: Holds a multi-turn conversation about connected database data through the /chat endpoint under the chat scope.

skills.name: Build Dashboards
skills.description: Creates and retrieves dashboards over the /dashboards endpoints for recurring reporting on connected databases.

skills.name: Run Workflows
skills.description: Defines and triggers scheduled database workflows via /workflows and POST /workflows/{id}/run.

skills.name: Saved Queries
skills.description: Stores and re-runs named queries through the /saved-queries endpoints for repeatable database reporting.
